subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and what auth, storage, validation, overwrite, and identity-precedence rules should it use?
rationale: The requested UI is useful, but it crosses a new file-upload and workspace-write boundary, so automation should not choose the security model or identity source-of-truth policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves current read-only avatar route protections.

options.title: Keep browser-local override only
options.body: Continue supporting the current Quick Settings override plus manual CLI/config/`IDENTITY.md` workflows while avoiding new server-side upload risk.

options.title: Defer core upload
options.body: Leave this open or close later as product scope until a broader Control UI identity-management design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves current read-only avatar route protections.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest current-main and merged-history signal across the avatar route, Gateway method registry, and original avatar follow-up work.
